description: This Dart file defines the 'ReviewsScreen' Flutter widget, which displays a list of reviews with aggregate ratings, and provides UI for adding new reviews including optional photo attachment.

classes.name: _ReviewInput
classes.description: A simple data class used to collect review input data from the review dialog.

classes.name: _ReviewDialog
classes.description: A stateful widget that provides a dialog UI for entering a new review, including rating, comment, and photo attachment.

classes.name: _ReviewDialogState
classes.description: The state class for '_ReviewDialog', managing user input and interaction logic.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the UI for 'ReviewsScreen', including app bar, reviews list, and add review button.

methods.name: _addReview
methods.description: Handles the process of creating a new review by showing the input dialog and adding the review via provider.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of text editing controller resources.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the alert dialog UI for adding a new review in '_ReviewDialog'.
